verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's core product generates AI insights and suggestions from the user's own code and repository data. The docs cover multi-model PR analysis with actionable feedback, generated PR summaries and walkthroughs, and suggested fixes for CI failures. Conversational chat covers follow-up questions about changes, and natural-language codebase investigation cross-references Sentry and Jira. Community users confirm the reviews catch real bugs; reports of false positives are about quality, not whether the capability exists. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-generated insights over the org-level dashboard metrics (the dashboard is described only as metrics and visibility), and independent corroboration of the chat and investigation features beyond PR reviews.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: CodeRabbit analyzes your code with multiple AI models and provides actionable feedback, catching issues that are easy to miss in manual reviews.
CodeRabbit appends a generated summary to the bottom of the PR description after a review.
CodeRabbit reads the failure output and posts inline comments with suggested fixes
Ask questions about your codebase, trace features, and cross-reference Sentry errors with merged PRs and Jira issues, all in natural language.
Ask questions about the change you are reviewing in a conversation pinned to its review snapshot.
It is able to catch bugs that even claude code misses on our Github PRs.
